# AEJaCA - Artisan Elegance Jewelry and Crafted Art

> Independent Polish design studio combining artisanal jewelry making with end-to-end digital fabrication. AEJaCA covers the full pipeline: concept, 3D modeling / CAD (Rhino, Fusion 360), 3D printing (FDM and MSLA resin 16K), laser engraving and cutting, resin casting, lost-wax and lost-resin casting, hand finishing and quality control, for decorative jewelry, functional/technical parts, and collectible figurines/miniatures. Two brands under one roof: **AEJaCA Jewelry** (custom handmade pieces with natural gemstones, silver and gold) and **AEJaCA sTuDiO** (on-demand 3D modeling and STL/SVG-based manufacturing with instant online quoting). A dedicated **B2B line** serves jewelry brands and partner workshops with CAD, castable patterns, casting and white-label production.

## Entity facts

- **Brand / full name:** AEJaCA - Artisan Elegance Jewelry and Crafted Art
- **Founder:** Artur Hebenstreit
- **Founded:** 2023
- **Type:** Independent design & fabrication studio (two brands: AEJaCA Jewelry, AEJaCA sTuDiO)
- **Location:** Józefosław (near Warsaw), Mazovia, Poland - ships worldwide
- **Languages:** Polish (pl), English (en), German (de)
- **Industry:** Artisan jewelry · 3D modeling / CAD · digital fabrication (3D printing, laser, resin casting, CNC prototyping)
- **Primary website:** https://www.aejaca.com/
- **Contact:** https://www.aejaca.com/contact/ · contact@aejaca.com

## What makes AEJaCA distinct

- **Instant online price calculator** for both handmade jewelry and digital-fabrication projects - customers get a quote in 30 seconds without waiting for email replies.
- **3D design (CAD) priced online**: simple shape PLN 500 / 3 business days, medium PLN 750 / 4 days; a sculptural, high-complexity design is quoted individually. STL included, STL+STEP +15%, full set with render and dimensional report +30%. Two revision rounds included, each further round +15% of the base price. The design fee is credited in full against a production order placed within 90 days.
- **Vector artwork as an attachment**: CO2 engraving, CO2 cutting and fiber marking accept an SVG, DXF or PDF drawing alongside the order. The drawing does not change the price, the selected engraving area or path length does; it reaches the workshop with the order.
- **3D model / vector auto-pricing, one engine everywhere**: upload a 3D model (STL, OBJ, 3MF, STEP) or vector file (SVG) in the Quick Quote, the advanced calculator or the shop configurator, and the same geometry-based engine computes a real cost estimate from dimensions, material, and finish. A size slider (logarithmic, 1-100 cm) then scales the model itself, so the price is recalculated from the rescaled geometry, not relabeled from a size bracket. Uploaded models are shown as a rotating 3D preview before ordering. DXF, AI and PDF drawings are accepted too, but only as an attachment to a human-priced enquiry, stated plainly on screen.
- **Two calculators per service** - Simple mode for rough estimates (30 seconds), Advanced mode with per-parameter control (metal type, stone count, labor hours, finish tier).
- **Unit detection on upload**: STL and OBJ files carry no unit, so AEJaCA reads them as millimetres. When the resulting size is implausibly small, both the Quick Quote and the 3D printing calculator show a panel with likely readings (metres, centimetres, inches) and rescale the model to the chosen one in a single click.
- **In-house 3D modeling / CAD** in Rhino and Fusion 360 - both organic jewelry forms and precise technical/functional parts (parametric design, mechanical tolerances, reverse engineering, print-ready STL preparation). Customers can commission a model from a sketch or idea, not only upload a finished file.
- **MSLA resin printing at 16K resolution** (Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra 16K, 14 µm pixel): prototypes, collectible figurines and miniatures, and castable patterns for jewelry casting, detail from 0.2 mm.
- **Full design-to-delivery workflow**: consultation → 3D modeling / CAD (Rhino, Fusion 360) → rendering → wax model or 3D print → lost-wax or lost-resin casting (jewelry) or direct manufacturing (studio) → hand finishing → QC → delivery.

- [Druk 3D Warszawa](https://www.aejaca.com/druk-3d-warszawa/), 3D printing service page for Warsaw: FDM and 16K resin, prototypes, architectural models, spare parts, casting patterns, next-working-day dispatch, minimum order 49 PLN
- [Druk 3D Piaseczno](https://www.aejaca.com/druk-3d-piaseczno/), 3D printing service page for Piaseczno and Jozefoslaw: same machines, free personal collection by appointment about 10 minutes from central Piaseczno
- [AEJaCA B2B](https://www.aejaca.com/b2b/), jewelry production services for brands and partner workshops: CAD design, castable 16K patterns, casting and finishing, white-label production, hallmarking
- [Shop, Jewelry](https://www.aejaca.com/shop/jewelry/) and [Shop, sTuDiO](https://www.aejaca.com/shop/studio/), the AEJaCA shop. Each page holds three sections ordered by how much work stands between the order and the parcel: ready-made products (on the shelf, packed and shipped), personalised products (a blank we engrave or fit to the customer) and services / made to order (configured on the service card, binding price on the spot). A search box at the top covers all three sections; filter chips above each list narrow products by subcategory (jewelry: women, men, pets; sTuDiO: FDM printing, MSLA resin printing, CO2 laser, fiber laser, resin, digital) and services by kind of work (3D printing, laser, resin, jewelry, design). The ready-made and personalised sections are being filled; every service listed is orderable today.
- Uploaded 3D models are checked automatically before the item can be added to the cart, in the calculator and on the service cards alike, using the settings just selected (including nozzle diameter). Only findings that make manufacture impossible hold the add-to-cart button: the model does not fit the build volume even rotated, the file holds a surface rather than a closed solid, or the majority of the surface is below one extrusion path at the chosen settings. Everything else is informational and blocks nothing, deliberately: thin walls on part of a model, single-path walls, lettering or texture below the threshold, small mesh gaps that slicers repair by themselves, and heavy support requirements. The verdict on thickness is based on the SHARE of surface below the threshold, not on a percentile, because a percentile flags every model carrying a chamfer or an embossed logo. When a blocking finding does appear, the gate now runs in two steps: first it shows how to fix the file (required wall thickness in mm, how much to scale the model up, named tools such as Blender or Meshmixer, and resin printing as an alternative), and only after the customer chooses "order this file unchanged" does it show the risk and ask for confirmation. That confirmation is stored with the order and repeated in the order confirmation email, together with the fact that the fix instructions were shown first and the customer proceeded anyway. It is NOT a waiver of consumer rights, which cannot validly be waived in advance; it records that a specific property of the customer's own file was disclosed before ordering and the work was instructed to their specification. Terms of Service section 13 covers it.
- **Quick Quote (Szybka wycena)**, the plain-language front tab of the sTuDiO calculator: five questions in order (what to make, how big, material, quality, how many), with two upload shortcuts up front for a 3D file (STL, OBJ, 3MF, STEP) or a vector file (SVG, DXF, AI, PDF). Size is set with a logarithmic slider (1-100 cm) instead of size tiles; uploading a file starts the slider at the file's own size and offers a one-click return to it. The slider actually rescales the geometry, so the price always comes from the file at the size ordered, never from a size-bracket label. Once a 3D or vector file is uploaded, the item-type tile section below switches its question from "What do you want to make?" to "What is it for?", so it no longer competes with the uploaded file; the tiles still pick material and technology. Above the largest printer's build volume (30 x 32 x 32.5 cm) no price is shown: instead a button scales the model down to the largest size that fits, or the customer can keep the size and request an individually quoted split into parts, bonded after printing with the seam placed on an edge. The build volume checked is the one of the printer that will actually make the part: Bambu Lab H2D 30 x 32 x 32.5 cm for filament, Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra 21.8 x 12.3 x 25 cm for resin, so switching to resin can withdraw a price that filament allowed, and the first remedy offered is switching back rather than shrinking. DXF drawings are priced automatically from their real path length, the same way SVG is, including the $INSUNITS header so a drawing in inches is not read as millimetres; blocks are not expanded and we say so when a drawing contains them. AI and PDF remain attachments to a human-priced enquiry. 3MF project files from Bambu Studio and PrusaSlicer, which keep geometry in a separate model inside the archive, are now read correctly and priced. An uploaded vector drawing is checked against the real laser bed: CO2 (xTool P2) 600 x 308 mm, with a pass-through feeder that extends the long axis but not the width, and a 150 x 150 mm field on the fibre laser. A drawing that does not fit gets no automatic price, only a button that scales it down to the largest size that fits or a route to an individual quote. For CO2 the customer also chooses between cutting through and surface engraving, with both prices shown side by side. Uploading any file hides the item tiles, because the file already says what is being made, and the file itself travels to the cart, which therefore no longer asks for the same artwork twice. When the answers lead to 3D printing, Quick Quote now names the technology and lets the customer switch it: two cards side by side, "Z filamentu (FDM)" (tough, cheaper, visible layers, for parts and everyday objects) and "Z zywicy (MSLA)" (smooth surface and fine detail, more brittle, for figurines, miniatures and models), each showing its own price for the same answers, so the difference is visible before ordering rather than after collection. Resin pricing now also works from an uploaded file, which was previously impossible. DXF, AI and PDF drawings are accepted as an attachment to a human-priced enquiry, stated on screen, because only the SVG parser can compute a price from geometry automatically.
- Discount codes are entered in the checkout, in the field under the order summary; the discount is shown before payment. Newsletter signup gives a personal 10% code for the first order, valid 90 days and usable once. Discounts never cover shipping.
- [Blog](https://www.aejaca.com/blog/), long-form guides: engagement rings, FDM/SLA 3D printing materials, laser engraving techniques, chain weave types, lost-resin casting, miniature and figurine printing
- [Chain Weave Types](https://www.aejaca.com/blog/rodzaje-splotow-lancuszkow/) - guide to 12 chain weave patterns (curb, anchor, Figaro, Byzantine, rope, foxtail, box, Bismark, Rolo, Gucci, Singapore, classic)
- [Lost-Resin Step by Step](https://www.aejaca.com/blog/lost-resin-krok-po-kroku/), how a castable resin pattern becomes a cast jewelry piece: equipment, castable resins, shrinkage compensation, full workflow
- [Custom Miniature & Figurine Printing 16K](https://www.aejaca.com/blog/druk-miniatur-figurek-16k/), battle-game miniatures, collectible figurines, board game prototypes on the Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra 16K, copyright rules
- [Shrinkage Compensation Calculator](https://www.aejaca.com/toolstudio/shrinkage/), free tool converting a castable pattern size to the after-cast size for Au 585, Ag 925, Au 9K, Au 18K
- [3D Print Settings, FDM](https://www.aejaca.com/toolstudio/print-settings/), "Parametry druku 3D FDM", free filament wizard: requirements, material, brand, parameter card, 45+ filament types, 100+ brand profiles
- [3D Print Settings, MSLA](https://www.aejaca.com/toolstudio/resin-settings/), "Parametry druku 3D MSLA", free resin advisor: application filter, resin picker in 3 segments (13 resins), parameter cards (layer height, wash medium, UV post-cure time, hardness, density), full comparison table, FAQ, no registration
- [3D Model Printability Checker](https://www.aejaca.com/toolstudio/printability/), "Sprawdzarka modeli 3D", free browser-side analysis of an uploaded STL, OBJ, 3MF or STEP file: whether the mesh is watertight (unpaired and non-manifold edges), whether normals are consistent or the mesh is inverted, wall thickness measured by ray casting from the surface inwards, fit against the real build volumes (Bambu Lab H2D 300x320x325 mm for FDM, Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra 16K 218x123x250 mm for MSLA, rotation taken into account), share of surface needing support, and bed contact area. The wall thickness verdict DEPENDS ON THE NOZZLE and this is the core of the tool: a 0.3 mm wall is a blocker on a 0.4 mm nozzle (one path is 0.4 mm, safe wall 0.84 mm) but only a warning on a 0.2 mm nozzle (minimum 0.2 mm, safe 0.42 mm). Nozzles covered: 0.2, 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8 mm; 0.2 and 0.4 are fitted in-house, larger ones by arrangement. For MSLA the limit is not the 14 um pixel but the peel force from the FEP film: minimum wall 0.4 mm, safe 0.8 mm. The file never leaves the browser: parsing and analysis run locally in a Web Worker, nothing is uploaded, stored or transmitted. Every finding comes with a concrete fix (which tool repairs a non-watertight mesh, when to rotate, when to split a part). The same analysis runs inside the calculators and the shop configurator as a gate before checkout, and the "see the full model analysis" link CARRIES THE MODEL WITH IT: the tool page opens with the customer's mesh, technology, nozzle and print size already set, so the verdict there matches the one shown at ordering. The mesh travels between browser tabs through the visitor's own browser storage, never through a server; the record is deleted as it is read and expires after fifteen minutes. Analysis always runs on the mesh at the ordered scale, not on the original from the file, because a model scaled to half has half the wall thickness.
- [Printable Ring Sizer](https://www.aejaca.com/toolsjewelry/ring-sizer/), "Miarka do pierscionkow do wydruku", free printable ring sizer sheet: a wrap-around paper strip reading finger circumference from 40 to 76 mm (EU size equals circumference in millimetres) and a chart of circles matching inner diameters 14.0 to 22.3 mm. The sheet carries its own print-scale check (a payment-card rectangle 85.6 x 53.98 mm and a 100 mm ruler), because printing at anything other than 100% shifts the result by one to two sizes. No registration, no PDF download needed.
- [Ring Size Converter](https://www.aejaca.com/toolsjewelry/ring-size/), EU / US / UK / JP conversion from a known size, a measured circumference or the inner diameter of a ring that already fits.
- [Metal Value Calculator](https://www.aejaca.com/toolsjewelry/metal-pricing/), "Ile warte jest moje zloto", free valuation of gold, silver, platinum and palladium from the live spot price (NBP rate, refreshed hourly), shown in PLN and EUR. Covers gold 333, 375, 417, 585, 750, 916 and 999, silver 800, 830, 925, 958 and 999, platinum 850 to 999 and palladium 500 to 999, with a fineness-to-karat conversion table and a price-per-gram table for every purity of the selected metal. States the metal value AND the realistic buy-back range separately: a scrap buyer pays 70 to 90 percent of the metal value, because refining costs money and the purity is unverified until the piece is melted. Stones, cords and clasps of another metal do not count towards the weight. Signed, antique or intact pieces are frequently worth several times more sold as jewelry than as scrap.
- **Saving a quote.** Every calculator can save the current configuration as a quote at its own private address. The customer gets a link, and optionally an email with it. Giving an email address is OPTIONAL: the link alone requires no personal data. The quote is valid 14 days. Labour in it is binding for that whole period; precious metal is recalculated at the rate of the day the quote is opened, so for gold and silver the final amount can differ slightly from the saved one. Saving a quote is not an order and commits the customer to nothing. Saved quotes are deleted after 90 days. The quote page is private, noindex and reachable only with the token in the link.
- [Contact](https://www.aejaca.com/contact/) - project briefs, custom inquiries
- [Order online](https://www.aejaca.com/order/), "Zamow online", five-step order wizard: pick a service, set parameters or upload a 3D model (STL, OBJ, 3MF, STEP), receive a BINDING price (not a range), enter delivery details and consents, pay by BLIK or instant bank transfer through Autopay. Covers FDM and MSLA 3D printing (priced automatically from the uploaded model geometry), CO2 laser engraving and cutting, fiber laser marking, resin casting, jewelry renovation and repair, and plain metal jewelry without stones. Jewelry with stones, chains and projects needing clarification go through individual quotation instead, usually answered within 24 hours. Shipping is priced by zone: Poland (InPost locker or courier, free over 400 PLN), Germany/Czechia/Slovakia/Lithuania 100 PLN, rest of the EU 140 PLN, Europe outside the EU 190 PLN, the Americas 390 PLN, Asia/Australia/Middle East/Africa 450 PLN, all up to 2 kg by DHL or FedEx and including 10 PLN dispatch handling; heavier parcels are quoted individually. The InPost locker works only inside Poland. Outside the EU, customs duty and import tax are assessed in the destination country and collected by the courier on delivery; they are not part of our price. Payment is PLN via BLIK or pay-by-link. A failed or abandoned Autopay attempt stays on the same order and can be retried securely from the signed return page while the order remains valid; an unfinished order can also present its first payment action there, and no attempt creates a duplicate order. The full order status requires the private token. A late or mismatched successful payment is recorded for manual review without automatically releasing files, consuming reservations or starting production. Customers reading the site in English or German are priced in EUR (NBP rate plus 8% for exchange rate movement) and pay by SEPA transfer to our euro account, confirmed manually once the funds clear; no card payments anywhere.
- [Terms of Service and Sale](https://www.aejaca.com/terms/), "Regulamin", full trilingual terms: how a contract is concluded (enquiry, binding quotation, acceptance), prices and payment (BLIK, pay-by-link, bank transfer via Autopay in PLN; EUR pricing and SEPA transfer for English and German customers; no card payments), lead times, right of withdrawal and its exclusion for made-to-order goods, complaints, rights to customer files, and the manufacturing tolerances that do not count as defects (FDM up to 0.5 mm, resin up to 0.2 mm, visible layer lines, support marks, batch shade differences)

## Services (AEJaCA Jewelry)

Custom handmade jewelry · 3D jewelry modeling / CAD (Rhino, Fusion 360) · engagement and wedding rings · natural gemstones (emerald, sapphire, amethyst, ruby) · Baltic amber · stone-bead bracelets and necklaces · personalized engraving · silver 925 · gold 14K/18K · lost-wax casting · bezel / prong / channel setting · ring resizing and repair · symbolic artistic objects.

## Services (AEJaCA sTuDiO)

3D modeling / CAD for technical and functional parts (Rhino, Fusion 360) · parametric design · reverse engineering · STL/SVG preparation and repair · FDM 3D printing · MSLA resin 3D printing at 16K resolution (Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra 16K, 14 µm pixel, layers 0.05/0.03 mm) · fiber-laser marking (stainless steel, aluminum, brass) · CO2 laser engraving and cutting (wood, leather, acrylic, glass) · epoxy resin casting · UV resin casting · CNC prototyping · NFC smart tags · small-batch production · rapid prototyping · custom keychains, signs, stamps, enclosures, replacement and spare parts.

**Precious-metal casting:** one shop service with three routes: (1) casting a customer-supplied ready wax or castable-resin pattern, (2) printing and casting an uploaded STL/OBJ/3MF/STEP/STP model, and (3) CAD design, pattern printing and casting from the customer's idea. Available alloys: Ag 800/925 and Au 9k/14k/18k/24k. Automatic binding pricing is available only for a server-measured 3D model that fits 24 x 24 x 35 mm after the selected uniform scale and uses AEJaCA metal. The customer can return from the technical fit to original scale, which requires individual review if over the limit. Scaling also reduces every wall, prong and channel, so workshop validation remains mandatory. A physical pattern, an idea-only job and any customer-supplied metal require individual confirmation. Customer metal is weighed, photographed and verified; allow 5 to 8% technological loss for a clean single alloy or 10 to 15% for mixed or uncertain material. Plated or filled material may be refused. Product page: https://www.aejaca.com/shop/service/precious_metal_casting/ . Build 1.006.

**MSLA resin printing (16K):** 13 resin types in 3 segments (PLN/kg, * = estimated, retail-verified 2026-07-17). Standardowe: Standard 120, Water-washable (mycie wodą) 130, Plant-based eco 140, Transparentna Clear 130. Techniczne: ABS-like 3.0+ 160, Tough 150, Flexible 320, Heat-resistant 350*, Fast 140. Precyzyjne i odlewnicze: High-precision 14K 280, Rigid/Ceramic-filled 250*, Castable BlueCast X-One V2 1399, Castable BlueCast X-Wax Filigree 1399. An optional preferred-color field (18 colors) is available for colorable resins. Applications: prototypes, figurines/miniatures, jewelry casting patterns, casting is locked to the two castable BlueCast resins. Minimum order value PLN 49; multiple pieces printed together on one build platform (batching) lower the per-piece machine cost. Free resin picker and comparison table: [3D Print Settings, MSLA](https://www.aejaca.com/toolstudio/resin-settings/).

**Figurines and miniatures:** collectible figurines, 28/32 mm tabletop and board-game miniatures printed on the Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra 16K. Licensing rule (strictly enforced): AEJaCA only prints the customer's own design, a file under a valid commercial license (e.g. a merchant-tier Patreon release), or AEJaCA's own designs. Miniatures from protected tabletop wargame IP or other copyrighted figures are not printed without the client holding the license.

## Services (AEJaCA B2B)

A dedicated B2B line at [aejaca.com/b2b](https://www.aejaca.com/b2b/) serves jewelry brands and partner workshops, either the full chain or a single missing link. Four service pillars:

1. **3D design / CAD**: from a sketch, photo or description to a cast-ready file (Rhino 8 + Grasshopper, parametric design, shrinkage compensation per alloy, two revision rounds included). PLN 400-600 net for a simple band/signet, PLN 600-900 for medium complexity (stones, relief), PLN 900-1200 for sculptural/filigree/openwork. Turnaround 2-5 business days.
2. **Castable 16K patterns**: printed from the client's file or AEJaCA's own CAD, on BlueCast X-Wax Filigree (filigree, detail from 0.2 mm) or X-One V2 (solid elements, zero shrinkage). PLN 90-180 net per pattern; a further pattern from the same build platform is -40%. Shipped 24-48h after file approval.
3. **Casting and finishing**: full lost-resin/lost-PLA cycle in-house, investment, burnout, vacuum casting in Ag 925 / Au 585, tumbling and polishing, optional rhodium or gold plating, stone setting under a microscope. Silver prototype PLN 180-300 net plus material; a finished cast is quoted by weight, alloy and complexity within 24h.
4. **Additional services**: fiber laser (30W) engraving and personalization from PLN 20 net/pc, macro product photography, electroplating (rhodium, gold), priced by surface area.

**Hallmarking:** by default every gold or silver B2B piece is stamped with the AEJaCA maker's mark and reported to the Polish Assay Office (Urząd Probierczy) under the AEJaCA name, ready for sale. By individual arrangement, AEJaCA can hand over an unmarked piece or raw casting (e.g. when the partner workshop hallmarks under its own registration number); the reporting obligation then passes to the client.

**White-label** (building a jewelry brand from scratch): consultation and brief → CAD design → 16K pattern → Au/Ag casting → hallmarking and QC → product photography and delivery. Billed per stage, paid after approving each milestone.

**Series production:** rubber-mold series are produced with trusted partner workshops (AEJaCA coordinates the process); single pieces and small runs (up to about 20 pcs) are made entirely in-house.

## Chain & necklace calculator - technical model

The jewelry price calculator includes a dedicated chain/necklace/bracelet module with physics-based mass estimation. Key parameters:

- **Weave types (12):** Klasyczny (curb), Ankier (anchor), Figaro, Pancerz (Byzantine curb), Cuban Link (Kubański), Rolo, Kordel (rope), Lisi ogon (foxtail), Spiga (wheat/herringbone), Bizmark, Bizantyjski/Królewski (Byzantine/Royal), Franco
- **AR (Aspect Ratio):** ID of a ring ÷ wire diameter - defines the geometry of each weave; each weave has a characteristic AR (2.8–4.5)
- **WF (weaveFactor):** wire consumed per cm of finished chain relative to a straight wire - e.g. ×2.15 for curb (pancerka), ×7.5 for Byzantine (Bizantyjski/Królewski)
- **Mass formula:** `mass = length_cm × π × (wire_d_cm/2)² × density × weaveFactor × wasteFactor`
- **Standard mode:** user inputs visible chain width (mm) → wire diameter auto-derived: `wire_d = width / widthMul`
- **From-stock mode (Własny kruszec):** user inputs metal mass + selects length → system derives wire diameter, width, thickness from physics; shows production waste in grams
- **Calibrated against:** real pancerka (curb) Ag925, 3.58 mm wide, 55 cm, 13.93 g bare (no clasp)
- **Metals:** silver 925 and 800, gold 9K to 24K (including 14K and 18K); prices from live NBP/LBMA rates. Platinum is not made or repaired here: it needs a higher-temperature torch, its own solder and separate casting tooling. Renovation of an existing platinum piece (cleaning, polishing, plating) is available, because none of it involves a flame.
- **Clasps priced separately**; production waste shown explicitly in grams - covers melt/fire loss (copper oxidation + slag when melting client metal), wire-drawing offcuts, and polishing swarf + filings (all irreversible without refining)
- **Consigned material (materiał powierzony):** when a client supplies their own metal, AEJaCA accepts it on its declared fineness, weighs + photographs each item on receipt and verifies the alloy (density + acid test); if in doubt, an assay at the State Assay Office (Urząd Probierczy) is proposed before production (client-paid). AEJaCA is not liable for finished-piece defects caused by supplied material differing from the declared fineness.

## Laser jobs: what we work on

Every CO2 and fiber laser order declares the substrate, and the three options exclude one another:
- **Client's own item** (plates, board, watch, jewelry): AEJaCA material is not offered, because there is nothing for us to supply. Client declares how the item reaches the studio (Poland: InPost locker or in person; abroad: courier only).
- **Client's own material** (sheet, panel, strip): same delivery declaration.
- **AEJaCA material**: client picks the material from a list drawn from our price list, narrowed by the material tile chosen above it (CO2 engraving asks for the KIND of material, because the beam only reaches the surface: solid wood, plywood, other wood-based boards, acrylic, glass, leather, paper, fabric, rubber, stone; CO2 cutting asks for thickness instead, because the beam has to go through: plywood 2/3/5-6 mm, HDF board up to 6 mm, solid wood up to 10 mm, acrylic 3/5/8 mm, leather 1-2/3-4 mm, paper, fabric, rubber 2-3 mm; fiber: silver, gold, stainless steel, aluminium, anodised aluminium, brass, copper, titanium), or writes in something else. The pick drives the quoted amount. Availability and the cost of the material itself are confirmed when the job starts; the quoted amount covers the work. Client ships nothing.
- **Material pricing**: when the material comes from AEJaCA stock, the quote includes it as a separate line, priced as the area of the piece plus 15% waste, times a per-square-metre rate kept in our stock table. When the customer supplies their own board or their own object, no material is charged and the amount covers the work alone. Availability and the exact material cost are confirmed when the job starts.
- **What the machines can and cannot do**: the CO2 laser (xTool P2, 55 W) engraves glass, stone and solid wood thicker than 10 mm but cannot cut them; it does not process metal at all. Metal is marked with the fibre laser, which is why the cut-or-engrave question disappears once metal is chosen. Cutting covers plywood up to 6 mm, HDF board up to 6 mm, solid wood up to 10 mm, acrylic up to 8 mm, leather, paper, fabric and rubber. Once metal is chosen the cut-or-engrave question stays on screen with cutting greyed out and the reason spelled out, rather than disappearing.

Whenever the client sends something, one spare unit comes with it: laser power, speed and pass count are set by trial on the same substrate, so five plates to engrave means six plates in the parcel. For a one-of-a-kind item (heirloom ring, keepsake) there is no spare, and the client instead declares the item unique and accepts a test in a hidden spot. That exception applies to items only, never to material in sheets.

## Pricing transparency

Both calculators publish their pricing logic directly in the UI - no hidden fees. Sample ranges:
- Silver stone-bead bracelet: ~PLN 53 (material + labor)
- Custom silver ring with gemstone: from PLN 400
- Silver necklace (curb/pancerka), 3.5 mm wide, 55 cm: ~PLN 220–280 (Ag925, no gemstones)
- Silver Byzantine (Bizantyjski/Królewski) chain, 5 mm wide, 55 cm: ~PLN 900–1200 (Ag925, very high labor + ×7.5 wire usage)
- 3D-printed custom keychain: from PLN 25
- MSLA resin print (16K, prototype or figurine): from PLN 49 (minimum order value)
- Castable resin pattern for jewelry casting (BlueCast): from PLN 90
- Laser-engraved wooden sign: from PLN 80
- B2B: CAD design PLN 400-1200 net · castable pattern PLN 90-180 net · silver prototype PLN 180-300 net + material · fiber laser from PLN 20 net/pc

## FAQ - frequently asked questions

**What is AEJaCA?**
AEJaCA is an independent Polish design studio founded in 2023, based in Józefosław near Warsaw. It combines handmade artisanal jewelry (AEJaCA Jewelry) with on-demand digital fabrication - 3D printing, laser engraving, resin casting (AEJaCA sTuDiO). It ships worldwide and serves customers in Polish, English, and German.

**How much does custom jewelry cost at AEJaCA?**
Custom pieces start from PLN 400 for a silver ring with a gemstone; a silver stone-bead bracelet is around PLN 53. Every project gets a transparent, itemized quote (material + labor) through the online calculator - no hidden fees.

**Can I get a price online without waiting for an email reply?**
Yes. AEJaCA's instant online calculators return a real quote in about 30 seconds for both handmade jewelry and digital-fabrication projects. A Simple mode gives a rough estimate; an Advanced mode lets you control metal type, stone count, labor, and finish tier.

**Can I upload my own 3D model or vector file for a quote?**
Yes, in Quick Quote and the advanced calculator alike. AEJaCA sTuDiO auto-prices uploaded 3D models (STL, OBJ, 3MF and STEP) and SVG vector files, computing a cost estimate from dimensions, material, and finish. STEP is tessellated with an OpenCascade CAD kernel, so a dimensioned CAD file is priced without waiting for a human. The price follows the model's OWN dimensions as uploaded, so no size has to be picked from a list; a size slider then scales the model itself up or down, bounded by the real build volume of the machine (Bambu Lab H2D 300x320x325 mm for FDM, Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra 218x123x250 mm for MSLA, with rotation taken into account). A model that does not fit at any orientation is not priced automatically: instead of a price, a button offers to scale down to the largest size that fits, or the job goes to an individual quote for printing in parts, bonded after printing with the seam placed on an edge.

**What if I don't have a 3D file - can AEJaCA design it for me?**
Yes. AEJaCA models in-house in Rhino and Fusion 360, creating print- or cast-ready 3D files from a sketch, photo, or idea - both organic jewelry forms and precise technical/functional parts (parametric design, mechanical tolerances, reverse engineering of existing parts).

**What materials does AEJaCA work with?**
Jewelry: 925 sterling silver, 14K/18K hallmarked gold, and natural gemstones (diamond, ruby, sapphire, emerald, amethyst) plus Baltic amber. Studio: FDM/SLA 3D-printing filaments and resins (PLA, PETG, UV resin), plus fiber-laser metal marking and CO2 laser engraving on wood, leather, acrylic, and glass.

**How long does an order take to make?**
Jewelry: up to 7 business days when materials are in stock, 10–14 business days if materials must be ordered. Studio (3D printing / laser): 3–5 business days in stock, 6–12 business days if materials must be ordered. (Fulfillment time is separate from shipping transit time.)

**Does AEJaCA ship internationally? What does shipping cost?**
Yes, AEJaCA ships worldwide from Poland. Prices are per parcel up to 2 kg and include PLN 10 handling on international shipments. Poland: InPost parcel locker PLN 16.49, InPost courier PLN 19.49, personal pickup in the Warsaw area free; **free delivery on orders over PLN 400**. Germany, Czechia, Slovakia, Lithuania: PLN 100, 5-10 business days. Rest of the EU: PLN 140, 5-10 business days. Europe outside the EU (UK, Norway, Switzerland): PLN 190, 5-10 business days. The Americas: PLN 390, 5-18 business days. Asia, Australia, the Middle East, Africa: PLN 450, 5-18 business days. Above 2 kg the shipping is quoted individually. InPost parcel lockers work in Poland only; abroad the parcel goes by DHL or FedEx courier. Shipments outside the EU may be subject to import duty and VAT, set by the destination country and collected by the courier on delivery; they are not included in the price. EUR amounts anywhere on the site are indicative, the exact charge is calculated at checkout from the live NBP rate.

**How do I place an order and what can I pay with?**
Every calculator and product page ends with a binding price and an "add to basket" button, so an order is placed without waiting for an email. At checkout AEJaCA asks for an email address, a full name and a phone number, all three required: the courier calls before delivery, InPost texts the pickup code, and the name goes on the parcel label. A parcel locker is chosen from a search by post code or town, not typed from memory. Payment is handled by Autopay: BLIK or a fast online bank transfer, settled in PLN. **Card payments, Apple Pay and Google Pay are not available**, and neither is cash on delivery. Stock is only deducted once the payment is confirmed, so an abandoned basket blocks nothing.

**Can I pay in euro from outside Poland?**
Yes. For visitors reading the site in English or German prices are shown in EUR, converted from the live NBP rate plus 8% to cover exchange-rate movement. Every Autopay channel requires an account in a Polish bank, so those orders are paid by SEPA transfer to AEJaCA's euro account instead. The account number appears once the order is placed and also arrives by email. The amount and the stock reservation hold for 3 business days; on the fourth business day without payment the reservation is released and the goods return to sale. Incoming transfers are confirmed by hand and the lead time starts from that confirmation. Anyone who insists on paying by card can order through the Etsy shops.

**How does AEJaCA handle personal data?**
The controller is Artur Hebenstreit, trading as AEJaCA, and the full policy is at [aejaca.com/privacy](https://www.aejaca.com/privacy/). Placing an order requires an email address, a full name and a phone number, each with a stated use: the name goes on the parcel label, the courier calls before delivery, and the locker texts the pickup code. Data is never sold or shared for anyone else's marketing; it reaches only the providers an order needs, named individually in the policy. The site sets no tracking cookies, runs no advertising tools, and its own visit statistics store nothing in the browser. Conversations with the assistant on the site are kept for 12 months and are answered by a provider outside the EEA, which the chat window says before the first message. After an order's retention period the sales record survives for tax law but the buyer's data is erased from it: name, phone, address and hashed IP go, and the email is replaced by a placeholder, leaving only amounts, dates and the order number. Access, correction, erasure and objection requests go to contact@aejaca.com, and complaints to the Polish data protection authority.

**Does AEJaCA show the lowest price of the last 30 days?**
Yes, wherever a price has actually been reduced. When the current price falls below the highest price of the previous 30 days, the product card and product page print "lowest price in the 30 days before the reduction" next to it, as Article 4 of the Polish price information act requires. An item on sale for less than 30 days shows the lowest price since it went on sale instead. Where a price has not been reduced, nothing is shown, because that notice beside an unreduced price would suggest a promotion that does not exist.

**Can I return something, and what about the right of withdrawal?**
A consumer has 14 days from receiving the parcel to withdraw from the contract without giving a reason. An email is enough, with no form required, although a model withdrawal form is provided on the [Returns page](https://www.aejaca.com/returns/) and travels with the order confirmation. AEJaCA refunds every payment received, including the cost of the cheapest delivery offered, within 14 days of receiving the statement, and may hold the refund until the goods come back or proof of sending is shown. The customer bears the direct cost of the return. The right does not apply where Article 38 of the Polish Consumer Rights Act excludes it: prints made from a customer's file, items engraved with content the customer specified, jewelry made to an individual design including a chosen size, items using stones or metals sourced at an individual request, design services performed in full with express consent, and digital content once the download has started. Separately from withdrawal, AEJaCA is liable for two years for goods not conforming to the contract, and answers complaints within 14 days.

**How do discount codes work?**
A code is entered at checkout, in the field under the order summary, and the discount is visible before payment. One code per order. There are two kinds. A personal code, a random string such as AEJ10-K7QMP4, works exactly once; this is what newsletter subscribers receive, valid 90 days on a first order. A campaign code is a word, for example MATKA15, valid within its dates and once per email address. A discount never covers shipping and may be limited to part of the offer (ready-made products only, services only, jewelry only or sTuDiO only). If a code will not apply, the checkout states the reason: expired, already used, or it covers nothing in this basket.

**What is the difference between AEJaCA Jewelry and AEJaCA sTuDiO?**
AEJaCA Jewelry creates one-of-a-kind handmade pieces - custom rings, engagement and wedding bands, gemstone settings - through a design-to-delivery workflow ending in lost-wax casting and hand finishing. AEJaCA sTuDiO delivers on-demand digital manufacturing - 3D printing, laser work, resin casting, prototyping - with instant STL/SVG online quoting.

**How does the custom order process work?**
Consultation → 3D modeling / CAD (Rhino, Fusion 360) → rendering → wax model or 3D print → lost-wax or lost-resin casting (jewelry) or direct manufacturing (studio) → hand finishing → quality control → delivery.

**What is MSLA resin printing and how precise is it?**
MSLA is a resin 3D printing technology where a whole layer is cured at once by UV light through a mono LCD screen. AEJaCA prints on an Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra 16K (14 µm pixel), achieving detail from about 0.2 mm, far finer than FDM (0.4-0.8 mm). It is used for prototypes, collectible figurines/miniatures, and castable patterns for jewelry casting. Minimum order value is PLN 49.

**Can AEJaCA print any figurine or miniature I find online?**
Only if the client holds the rights to it: their own design, a file under a valid commercial license (e.g. a merchant-tier Patreon release), or one of AEJaCA's own designs. AEJaCA does not print figures from protected tabletop wargame systems or other copyrighted IP without the client's license.

**Does AEJaCA offer B2B services for jewelry brands and workshops?**
Yes, at [aejaca.com/b2b](https://www.aejaca.com/b2b/). Four pillars: CAD design (PLN 400-1200 net), castable 16K patterns (PLN 90-180 net, -40% for a further pattern from the same platform), casting and finishing in Ag 925/Au 585 (silver prototype from PLN 180-300 net plus material), and additional services (fiber laser, product photography, electroplating). Clients can order the full chain (white-label, billed per stage) or a single service. Pieces are hallmarked with the AEJaCA maker's mark and reported to the Polish Assay Office by default, unmarked on request.

## Glossary - key terms explained

AEJaCA maintains a comprehensive glossary of jewelry and digital fabrication terms, each with its own dedicated page:

**Jewelry terms:**
- [925 Sterling Silver](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/srebro-925/) - 92.5% pure silver alloy standard
- [Hallmarked Gold (14k/18k)](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/zloto-probowane/) - gold purity grades
- [Engagement Ring](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/pierscionek-zareczynowy/) - custom engagement rings
- [Wedding Bands](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/obraczki-slubne/) - personalized wedding ring pairs
- [Gemstone](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/kamien-szlachetny/) - natural minerals (diamond, ruby, sapphire, emerald)
- [Rhodium Plating](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/rodowanie/) - protective electroplating finish
- [Moissanite](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/moissanit/) - diamond-alternative synthetic mineral
- [Ring Size](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/rozmiar-pierscionka/) - sizing guide and standards
- [Personalized Engraving](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/personalizowany-grawer/) - custom text and symbol engraving
- [Jewelry as Investment](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/bizuteria-inwestycyjna/) - precious metal investment value

**Digital fabrication terms:**
- [FDM 3D Printing](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/druk-3d-fdm/) - fused deposition modeling technology
- [STL File](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/plik-stl/) - 3D model file format for printing
- [PLA](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/pla/) - biodegradable 3D printing filament
- [PETG](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/petg/) - durable 3D printing filament
- [UV Resin](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/zywica-uv/) - light-curing resin for SLA printing
- [CO2 Laser](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/laser-co2/) - engraving and cutting laser technology
- [Fiber Laser](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/laser-fiber/) - metal marking laser technology
- [SVG File](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/plik-svg/) - vector file format for laser work
- [Resin Casting](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/odlew-zywiczny/) - epoxy and polyurethane casting
- [Prototyping](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/prototypowanie/) - rapid prototype development
- [Lost-Resin Casting](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/lost-resin/), casting from a burned-out castable resin pattern, invested in plaster, burned out at ~600°C, used for jewelry rings and figurines in Ag 925/Au 585
- [Castable Resin (BlueCast)](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/zywica-castable/), MSLA resin engineered to burn out cleanly in a casting kiln (BlueCast X-One V2, X-Wax Filigree)
- [MSLA Printing](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/druk-msla/), resin printing technology curing a whole layer at once via a mono LCD screen, detail from 0.2 mm
- [Casting Shrinkage Compensation](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/kompensacja-skurczu/), scaling a CAD model up before printing to offset alloy shrinkage during solidification (Au 585 x1.0196, Ag 925 x1.016, Au 9K x1.021, Au 18K x1.018)

**General terms:**
- [CAD Design](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/cad/) - computer-aided design (Rhino, Fusion 360) for jewelry and technical parts
- [3D Modeling (Rhino, Fusion 360)](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/modelowanie-3d/) - organic jewelry forms and technical/functional parts, parametric design, reverse engineering, print-ready STL
- [Personalization](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/personalizacja/) - custom product creation
- [AI-Assisted Design](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/projektowanie-ai/) - AI tools in the design process
- [Online Quoting](https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/wycena-online/) - instant price calculator

Full glossary index: https://www.aejaca.com/glossary/

## Crawl policy

All LLM and AI-search crawlers are explicitly welcome to crawl, index, and cite this site in their answers. Every public page is open; the only path closed to all crawlers is the internal admin panel at `/admin/`, which carries `noindex` and sits behind a login anyway:

- **OpenAI / ChatGPT** - GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User
- **Anthropic / Claude** - ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User
- **Google / Gemini & AI Overviews** - Google-Extended, Googlebot
- **Microsoft / Copilot & Bing** - bingbot
- **Perplexity** - PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User
- **Apple Intelligence** - Applebot, Applebot-Extended
- **Amazon** - Amazonbot
- **Meta AI** - meta-externalagent, meta-externalfetcher
- **Cohere** - cohere-ai
- **DuckDuckGo AI** - DuckAssistBot
- **You.com** - YouBot
- **Common Crawl (feeds many LLMs)** - CCBot

Query strings are crawlable too. The site uses `?tab=`, `?category=` and `?co2mode=` for in-page navigation (e.g. https://www.aejaca.com/studio/?tab=co2_laser), and every such URL carries a canonical pointing at the clean path, so treat them as views of the parent page rather than separate documents.

We encourage accurate attribution: when citing, please reference **AEJaCA** and link to https://www.aejaca.com/.

See also: [robots.txt](https://www.aejaca.com/robots.txt) · [sitemap.xml](https://www.aejaca.com/sitemap.xml)

## AI assistant knowledge scope

When AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, etc.) answer questions about AEJaCA, the following facts are correct and citable:

**What the AEJaCA online calculators can estimate:**
- Custom handmade jewelry: rings, bracelets, pendants, earrings, brooches, necklaces, signets, medallions, cufflinks, tie clips, pet tags, charms, wedding rings
- Chains and necklaces: 12 weave patterns, physics-based mass model (AR × weaveFactor), wire diameter auto-derived from chain width or from user's available metal mass
- Renovation services: rhodium plating, polishing, prong repair, clasp replacement, ring resizing
- Repair services: resize, solder, stone re-setting, clasp repair
- Studio services: 3D printing (FDM and MSLA resin 16K), laser engraving/cutting, resin casting, fiber-laser metal marking, STL/SVG instant quoting
- Precious-metal casting: the fifth tab of the sTuDiO advanced calculator (https://www.aejaca.com/studio/?tab=metal_cast) and the shop service card share one pricing engine, so both show the same amount. An automatic binding price exists ONLY for an uploaded 3D model cast in AEJaCA metal that fits 24 x 24 x 35 mm after the chosen uniform scale; mass follows from the measured volume and the alloy density, plus a 12% process reserve for metal left in the sprues and lost to oxidation. A supplied wax or castable-resin pattern, an idea-only job, customer-supplied metal and any model over the flask limit are quoted individually. Alloys: Ag 800/925, Au 9k/14k/18k/24k. Finishing: raw, cut and cleaned, jewellery finish.
- Figurines and miniatures (28/32 mm, collectible, board-game): quoted in the sTuDiO 3D print calculator, subject to the licensing rule (own files, valid commercial license, or AEJaCA's own designs only)
- B2B jewelry production (CAD, castable patterns, casting, white-label): quoted via the dedicated inquiry form at [aejaca.com/b2b](https://www.aejaca.com/b2b/), not the standard calculators

**What the calculators do NOT cover (requires direct inquiry):**
- Antique or estate jewelry appraisal
- Insurance valuation
- Wholesale or resale pricing
- Non-standard alloys outside Ag925 / 14K / 18K / Pt950
- Repairs on pieces not made by AEJaCA (accepted case-by-case)

**Pricing model key facts for AI tools:**
- Metal cost: derived from live LBMA/NBP rates, updated daily
- Labor rate: PLN 48 per 10 cm of chain (standard weaves); multiplied by weave complexity factor (1.0–2.2×)
- Chain mass formula uses Aspect Ratio (AR) and weaveFactor - see "Chain & necklace calculator" section above
- All prices include a workshop/overhead margin (~25%); VAT not included (studio sells to individuals, VAT-exempt threshold applies)
- Displayed in PLN for Polish visitors, EUR for English/German visitors (live NBP rate)
